クラス Enemy.AuraState

java.lang.Object
model.entity.Enemy.AuraState
含まれているクラス:
Enemy
private static final class Enemy.AuraState extends Object
Time-aware elemental aura state. The simulator still uses a simplified gauge model, but runtime-applied auras now decay continuously between application and expiry.

The aura value at any time is derived by linear decay from units at applicationTime down to zero at expiryTime, using a fixed decayRate (units per second). Auras created without a finite duration (legacy setAura(element, units)) use a zero decay rate and an infinite expiry, so they keep their stored units until they are explicitly cleared or consumed. This preserves compatibility for test fixtures and snapshot restore paths.

  • メソッドの詳細

    • currentUnitsAt

      private double currentUnitsAt(double currentTime)
      Returns the remaining aura units at the given simulator time after continuous natural decay. Infinite-expiry auras return their stored units unchanged. Queries at or before the application time return the full stored units (no decay has occurred yet).
      パラメータ:
      currentTime - simulator time in seconds to evaluate
      戻り値:
      remaining units, never negative

    • rebase

      private void rebase(double newUnits, double currentTime)
      Re-bases the aura so that newUnits are present at currentTime, and natural decay continues from there at the original decay rate. Infinite-expiry auras keep their infinite expiry.
      パラメータ:
      newUnits - remaining units after a discrete consumption event
      currentTime - simulator time of the consumption event
